Request account deletion.

Account closure is a manual, verified process. Sending a request does not close or delete an account.

Private preview · Policy review required. The operator must approve this process before public launch.

How to request a review

  1. Open the support form and select “Account deletion request.” Use the email associated with your Beter account.
  2. Explain what you want closed or reviewed. Do not include your password, verification codes, or payment information.
  3. Save the reference displayed after the request is accepted. The operator must verify ownership before changing account access or information.

Request account deletion

What the operator reviews

After verifying ownership, the operator reviews account closure, revocation of Cognito and application database sessions, and removal or anonymization of identity information where appropriate. The operator must confirm what was completed and explain any information retained. There is no automatic account-deletion action on this page and no promised completion deadline.

Immutable virtual ledger records may be retained to preserve consistency and can be deidentified. Security records, support email notifications, and backup copies may also remain subject to their operational retention or cleanup process. Closing sign-in access alone is not the same as removing every record.

Browser-only practice

If you used only anonymous practice or a sample portfolio, your saved practice may be local to this browser. You can clear Beter’s site data in browser settings. This removes the browser copy; it does not close a connected Beter account or remove hosted history.
